seeds.title: No pictures
seeds.description: Letters must be text only; photographs and printed images are returned.

seeds.title: No contraband
seeds.description: Nothing may be enclosed with a letter: no stamps, cash, cards, or objects of any kind.

seeds.title: Plain envelopes only
seeds.description: White or manila envelopes with no stickers, tape, drawings, or coloured ink.

seeds.title: Return address required
seeds.description: Every envelope needs a full sender name and postal address or it is refused.

seeds.title: Full name and number
seeds.description: Address mail with the prisoner's full legal name and inmate number; nicknames are not delivered.

seeds.title: Blue or black ink only
seeds.description: Letters written in pencil, marker, crayon, or coloured ink are rejected.

seeds.title: Plain paper only
seeds.description: White lined or unlined paper; no cardstock, construction paper, or scented paper.

seeds.title: No polaroids
seeds.description: Instant-film photographs are refused because the backing can hide contraband.

seeds.title: Photos: maximum 5
seeds.description: Up to five loose photographs per envelope, none larger than 4 by 6 inches.

seeds.title: No nude or suggestive photos
seeds.description: Photographs showing nudity, underwear, or sexually suggestive poses are destroyed.

seeds.title: No gang signs in photos
seeds.description: Photographs showing hand signs, gang colours, or gang tattoos are refused.

seeds.title: Page limit: 10
seeds.description: Letters over ten single-sided pages are returned to sender.

seeds.title: Page limit: 5
seeds.description: Letters over five single-sided pages are returned to sender.

seeds.title: Postcards only
seeds.description: This facility accepts standard-size postcards only; enclosed letters are returned.

seeds.title: No greeting cards
seeds.description: Cards with layers, glitter, pop-ups, or musical parts are refused; a flat card is accepted.

seeds.title: No stickers or labels
seeds.description: Address labels, stickers, and stamps other than postage are not allowed on the envelope.

seeds.title: No perfume or lipstick
seeds.description: Scented, stained, or lipstick-marked paper is treated as contaminated and destroyed.

seeds.title: No glue or tape inside
seeds.description: Nothing may be glued, taped, or stapled to the pages.

seeds.title: No newspaper clippings
seeds.description: Cuttings and printed articles are refused; write out or describe the content instead.

seeds.title: Printed internet pages allowed
seeds.description: Printed web pages are accepted if they are plain black-and-white text with no images.

seeds.title: Books from publishers only
seeds.description: Books must ship new from a publisher or approved bookseller, never from an individual.

seeds.title: Paperbacks only
seeds.description: Hardcover books are refused; send paperback editions.

seeds.title: No maps
seeds.description: Maps, including hand-drawn ones, are treated as escape material and confiscated.

seeds.title: No coded messages
seeds.description: Letters containing ciphers, symbols, or unexplained abbreviations are held for investigation.

seeds.title: English only
seeds.description: Mail in a language other than English is delayed for translation and may be refused.

seeds.title: Spanish or English
seeds.description: Mail is accepted in English or Spanish; other languages are delayed for translation.

seeds.title: Russian only
seeds.description: Mail must be written in Russian; letters in other languages are not delivered.

seeds.title: Scanned, not delivered
seeds.description: Incoming mail is scanned by a vendor and shown on a tablet; the paper original is destroyed.

seeds.title: Scanned mail: no colour
seeds.description: Because mail is scanned in greyscale, colour drawings and photos arrive as black and white.

seeds.title: Digital mail only
seeds.description: Letters must be sent through the facility's electronic mail service; postal mail is returned.

seeds.title: Mail opened and read
seeds.description: All incoming mail except legal mail is opened and read by staff before delivery.

seeds.title: Legal mail marked clearly
seeds.description: Mail from a lawyer must be marked Legal Mail with the firm's address or it is opened as ordinary mail.

seeds.title: No third-party mail
seeds.description: Mail that forwards or relays a message from someone else is refused.

seeds.title: No mail between prisoners
seeds.description: Correspondence with anyone held in another facility requires prior written approval.

seeds.title: No unknown senders
seeds.description: Only senders on the prisoner's approved correspondence list are delivered.

seeds.title: Sender approval form
seeds.description: New correspondents must file the facility's approval form before their first letter is delivered.

seeds.title: One letter per envelope
seeds.description: Envelopes containing letters for more than one prisoner are returned.

seeds.title: No money orders
seeds.description: Funds cannot be sent by mail; use the facility's deposit service.

seeds.title: Stamps not accepted
seeds.description: Enclosed postage stamps are confiscated; stamps must be bought at the commissary.

seeds.title: No drawings by others
seeds.description: Hand-drawn artwork is accepted only from the sender; drawings by children or others are refused.

seeds.title: Typed letters allowed
seeds.description: Typed and printed letters are accepted as long as the pages are unbound.

seeds.title: Registered post recommended
seeds.description: Ordinary international post is often lost; send letters by registered or tracked mail.

seeds.title: Delivery not confirmed
seeds.description: The facility does not confirm delivery; expect delays of four to eight weeks.

seeds.title: Holiday mail limits
seeds.description: In December only, up to two cards per sender are accepted.
